pose: Top-down bird's eye view of a 1-meter square quadrant
visual_description: A square mapping grid formed by four high-visibility yellow nylon strings. The strings are held in place by four heavy-duty steel survey stakes driven into the ground. Every 10cm on the string is marked with a small black bead. A small plastic 'North' arrow sits in the corner of the grid.

constraints.logic: Provides a mathematical structure to the messy dig site.
constraints.background: The grid is laid over a patch of neutral grey-brown 'matrix' soil to show contrast with the yellow string.
